scales_for_jacobian: Residual / manual pixel uncertainty; parameter increments scaled by [3,3,2,.5,.5,.5] working units/radians. Condition number is local under these chosen scales.
visibility: Base observations constrained to camera-facing radial half-ring; explicit seat_front/rear constrained to corresponding half. Open arcs exclude diameter chord. Camera above model cap by .05 working unit because source cap face is visible. This is a geometric half-space check, not full ray occlusion.
solver: scipy least_squares soft_l1 f_scale=1, fixed focal/shift, three documented starts; no geometry change
